rationale: Braking behavior itself must be characterised to evaluate prevention of unintended braking, as established by SG-3 and the H-3 hazardous event. P's declared operational scope matches H-3, and braking occurrence and manifestation directly concern the described sudden stop. P does not expand into sensing, computation, communication, failure mitigation, or mechanism timing merely because these may influence braking.
determining_elements: “Vehicle braking behavior” identifies the system behavior directly required by the evaluation target.
The scope specifies straight-ahead driving on a less frequented urban road at 50 km/h, without visible obstacles or vehicles ahead, in good weather—all explicitly supported by H-3.
“Whether braking occurs and its manifestation” concerns the braking phenomenon, including the sudden stop described in H-3, rather than supporting control or observation mechanisms.
